topic: Football YouTubers recreate famous impossible goals (Zlatan bicycle kick, Ronaldo etc.) in a stadium challenge scored by a panel
hero: Futcrunch friends/players (unidentified men in red and blue shirts)
hook: Rating meter UI with name ZLATAN, player in blue attempting overhead kick over a mat
subtitle_style: white bold sans-serif 'COMING UP' caption, lower centre; name labels and rating bar at left
reaction_overlays: rating-bar overlay, picture-in-picture reaction inset bottom-right, name tags, colour grading flashes
transition_summary: Fast hard cuts with flash/colour-tinted flashes, slow-motion replays, whip-zooms; about 5 cuts per 10 s
audio_note: voice-over/vlog narration per transcript ('my friends are competing to see who can score the most impossible goals'), music underneath

reuse_segments.what: Original creator-filmed challenge footage with graphics
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: own-shot content; recreate format with own players; strip channel names/logos
